description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the application to the latest supported Java framework/runtime baseline.
tasks.reason: The application currently targets Java 8 and legacy Java EE servlet APIs that should be modernized before cloud-native migration.
tasks.requirements: Modernize the Java runtime/framework to the latest supported baseline for this application and ensure compatibility with existing interest calculation endpoints.

tasks.description: Modernize core services to Azure cloud-native managed services.
tasks.reason: The per-plan execution goal explicitly requires cloud-native services as part of modernization.
tasks.requirements: Migrate SQL connectivity and secret handling from current local/plaintext patterns to Azure cloud-native services using managed identity patterns where applicable.

tasks.description: Scan dependencies for CVEs and remediate vulnerabilities before deployment.
tasks.reason: Security remediation is required for every modernization plan and reduces deployment risk.
tasks.requirements: Scan all dependencies for CVEs, upgrade vulnerable packages to patched versions, and document any major-version remediation impact.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized application to Azure.
tasks.reason: The project modernization goal explicitly requires Azure deployment.
tasks.requirements: Containerize as needed and deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps.
